name: @anywalletkit/protocol-swap2-across
description: Across Protocol with the SpokePool deposit built and verified on the device: EVM-to-EVM bridges of the same asset (USDC, USDT / USDT0, ETH / WETH, WBTC) between 17 chains. A plain deposit is encoded here from pinned SpokePools and the user's request, and every argument — depositor, recipient, tokens, amounts, destination, empty message, deadlines, a per-asset fee floor — is held to that request before signing; priced from Across API V5 against Across's relayer fee, V5's own execution steps never run; the API key stays on a server (acrossRemoteProvider in the app); status is read on chain.
